versions.content: Execution Management shall support self-initiated graceful shutdown of processes. Description: Execution Management shall support self-initiated graceful shutdown of Processes . Rationale: Self-initiated graceful shutdown enables a Process to free allocated dedicated resources and inform other interacting entities about its shutdown (e.g. de-registering a service) to create a consistent state within the Machine /vehicle. Self-initiated Process shutdown is, by definition, only be initiated by the Process itself. Dependencies: – Use Case: The process of an Executable instance is finished and shuts down itself.
